title: The Only Fruit-Eating Bird That Finds Its Way in the Dark
subject: oilbird

scenes.text: A bird that eats fruit, but flies through pitch-black caves.
It's the oilbird, the only nocturnal fruit-eating bird in the world.
Thousands roost together in caves. Each bird clicks at a slightly different pitch to hear its own echoes.
At night it flies as far as seventy-five miles from the cave to find fruit.
Its chicks get so fat they can outweigh their parents by half. People once melted that fat for oil and torches.
A bat's trick, in a bird.

description:
The oilbird eats fruit, yet it finds its way through pitch-black caves by clicking, like a bat.
It is the only nocturnal fruit-eating bird in the world, and its fat chicks were once melted down for lamp oil.
Which animal's superpower would you want?
